name: Volatile Stormdrake — hexproof from activated and triggered abilities stops Gilded Drake's trigger, not Switcheroo
notes: "Flying, hexproof from activated and triggered abilities" (CR 702.11d). The opponent's Stormdrake can be a target of your Switcheroo (a spell) and is exchanged, but not of Gilded Drake's enters trigger, whose list leaves it out and whose pair with it the engine refuses. Before (2026-10-18), "hexproof from …" counted as full hexproof, so Switcheroo could not take the Stormdrake either.
